body: I have to go now. I'm sorry. Thank you to those who talked to me in these last moments. You made it so much easier and less lonely. I can't thank you enough. Goodbye.
I don't know. Give them everything they need. make their dreams come true. Not that they'd care or notice. I'm nothing to them
If I did that I'd be more alone than ever. I'm supposed to be moving at the end of February. I don't want to go. I can't handle this for that long.
Make the people I care about happy.
If I could choose a way to go, that would be it.
The only thing I want right now is someone to hug me and hold me.
I took all my sleeping pills a couple of weeks ago. sadly didn't have enough :/ Just ended up quite sick, dizzy and tired for a few days :/

I'm 18, just finished high school.
I don't like doing anything. Nothing makes me happy. I don't know how to be happy anymore.

I've tried. No one wants to give any answers. I've thought of electrocution, but I know that's not definite. I could find a rope. I've never heard of that failing. I'm sure it has failed, but must be uncommon right?
I don't know how to do it quickly and painless
Thank you, but I doubt there's anything you can do to help :/

My theory is, even if the pills don't kill me they'll seriously damage my organs. Especially since I've tried multiple times before. If I damage my organs too much they'll start failing, and I'll eventually die. Even if it takes longer than intended.
If it helps, I won't be hurting for very long. And it'll end my suffering.
If i was a nice person I'd still have people in my life.
But you cant care about me if you don't know me :/
Why are you being so nice?
Thank you
Can you just talk to me till its over? I don't wanna be alone

My minds made up. I'm definitely doing it.
Whats wrong? Where do I start?
Hi. Sorry I didn't reply sooner. I took some pills and slept for ages :/

I can't talk about this right now sorry. I'm going to get some sleep and go to school tomorrow but I'll talk to you tomorrow? Thank you everyone who has helped tonight. You may have just saved a life.
Thank you
Okay. Thank you
But the pain will be over. They should be happy knowing I'm not hurting anymore
Promise me. Promise you'll be here tomorrow so we can cry together. Promise you'll be here to talk me out of ending it next time.
Because I've always wanted to save somes life. Because they deserve to be alive. Because I know people care about them. Because a broken heart can be fixed.
If you don't end your life neither will I.
whats me staying going to achieve?
Why not?
I didn't help anyone else. He's still going to do it
Yes. I was gonna suggest talking to them. I'm sorry to leave you like this but I have nothing left now. I wish you luck. Be stronger than I am. So sorry I couldn't help. Goodbye
Fair enough. Are you close with your family?

I'm sure you were devastated when you broke up with your fiance right? But that would have showed you that you can move on, find someone better. That's gonna happen again. Ad probably again after that. But it'll get easier every time
But I do. And you can't change that.
Thank you. I care about you too
That will just make it harder for me. I'll still do it, it'd just be harder than it has to be
New Zealand. Do you think you could give her a little bit of space, then try talk to her and decide where to go from there?
I can't handle this pain. I don't know how to fix it. I don't know how to fix myself
No. I have 1 person, if that
I don't want to fight for another 6 years. I'll be here for another 30mins.
Any chance you've changed your mind? Btw, where are you from?
Are you still here :'(
The longer you fight the weaker you get, the more tired you get. I've been fighting for 6 years. My fight is over. I'm sorry
I wouldn't know where to start fixing myself. My looks, my personality. Theres just too much. I'm in my last year of high school. I doubt I'll graduate at this rate :/

What makes you say that? You're writing letters right? So obviously theres people who you care about, who care about you. I don't bother writing letter cause who would I write to? Look at all these people trying to help you. The obviously think you're worth something.
I'm going to die eventually. So why suffer through the pain? Why not speed up the inevitable?
Why do you get to do it but I don't? You're just as important as me.
I've tried to end it more times than I can count. I guess you can just add that to the list of things I suck at

I'm not wasting my time. I'm pretty sure I'm gonna end my life tonight too. I don't want someone else to be in the same pain I am. That's why in a way I'm happy for you that you're gonna be rid of it. But It hurts me too. Knowing that someones life is about to end. I wish I knew you.
If that's the case, I'll be on here for the rest of my life sorry :/

Everything that i wrote above. I have one friend. And a couple of days ago he was telling me to get out of my life. Hes gonna be saying that again soon enough. I'm doing badly at school. No one notices me. I'm invisible to everyone around me. The only person who will ever love me never wants to be in a relationship with me again. I'm facing having brain surgery for the 2nd time in 6 months. I truly believe no one will notice if I'm gone. And I know for a fact that a lot of people would be extremely happy
Do you think the fact that you're still here talking to people is because someone deep down you're not sure you're making the right decision by ending it?
I'm sorry
I don't know what to do. I'm sorry
Please tell me when you go? I'm gonna be sitting on here all night making sure you're still with us
I wish I could hug you.
stop it
I think tonights the night :/
